faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our pricing

changePlan.q: Can I change my plan at any time?
changePlan.a: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately, and we'll prorate any charges or credits.

paymentMethods.q: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.a: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover), as well as bank transfers for enterprise plans.

freeTrial.q: Is there a free trial available?
freeTrial.a: Yes! All new users start with our Access plan which is completely free. You can upgrade to a paid plan at any time to unlock additional features.

dataDowngrade.q: What happens to my data if I downgrade?
dataDowngrade.a: Your data is always safe with us. If you downgrade to a plan with less storage, you'll have 30 days to download or delete excess data before older records are archived.

refunds.a: Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans. If you're not satisfied, we'll refund your payment in full, no questions asked.

hiddenFees.q: Are there any setup fees or hidden charges?
hiddenFees.a: No! The price you see is the price you pay. There are no setup fees, cancellation fees, or hidden charges of any kind.

yearlyDiscount.q: How does the yearly discount work?
yearlyDiscount.a: When you choose yearly billing, you save 10% compared to monthly billing. You'll be charged once per year instead of every month.

separatePlans.q: Can doctors and clinics have different plans?
separatePlans.a: Absolutely! Doctors and clinics operate independently with their own separate subscription plans tailored to their specific needs.
